rapport_notes: Patient with an uncertain closing date on a condo purchase, reassured her repeatedly that changes are easy with no deposit required.

evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "Basically the shorter the move, the lower the cost at the end of the day."

top_strength: Handled the uncertain move date smoothly, offering to hold the spot while explicitly noting there's no risk or deposit if the date shifts.
coaching_note: Communication (day-before call, named crew, inbox updates) never came up anywhere in the call - only two of the three Stage 2 differentiators landed.
